text_block_list.name: Shiori
text_block_list.text: Somehow we managed to beat him.
text_block_list.orig_text: なんとか倒せましたね。

text_block_list.name: Rin
text_block_list.text:
He was a tricky one, huh?
And what the heck was the inspector doing behind him?
text_block_list.orig_text:
油断ならないやつだったねぇ。
後ろにいた監査官は
何がしたかったのか分からないけど。

text_block_list.name: Lima
text_block_list.text:
Is skulking around at the back right until the end really fitting behavior
for someone who's supposed to lead...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
最後まで後ろでコソコソしてるの、
人の上に立つ者として
どうなのかしらねぇ……

text_block_list.name: Mahiru
text_block_list.text:
If ya ain't got the guts to stand an' fight, ya shouldn't play dirty
in the first place.
Hm? Looks like he's still up to somethin'.
text_block_list.orig_text:
先頭に立つ度胸がねぇなら、
最初っから悪いことなんてするもんでねぇよな。
ん？　
まだなんかするつもりみたいだべ。

text_block_list.name: Rin
text_block_list.text:
*sigh*... He doesn't know when to quit.
Let's stop him in his tracks before this gets anymore out of hand.
text_block_list.orig_text:
はぁ……
あきらめ悪いねぇ。
余計にめんどくさくなる前に
片づけちゃおうか。
